other_conditions: Applicant should be from one of the following target groups: Scheduled Caste, Scheduled Tribe, Other Backward Class, Minority, Persons with Disability.
Applicant should be willing to pursue one of the income‑generating activities given in the scheme guidelines.
Applicant must have a proper workplace, either owned or rented, for starting the proposed activity.
Applicant should not have been declared a defaulter under any of the schemes being implemented by DSFDC.
benefits_summary: Need‑based loan up to ₹3,00,000 for SC applicants and up to ₹1,00,000 for OBC, Minority and PwD applicants.
documents_required: Prescribed format of the application form
Copies of all mandatory documents (self‑attest, if required)
